item.worldBorder.desc: If you were able to obtain this you are either cheating or my game is broken ):
item.flint_hammer.desc: Can change the shape of blocks
item.nothing_bagel.desc: Give me a bagel with nothin'.
item.wand.desc: Used to select two points for commands.
item.entwiner.desc: Magically entwines a trigger to a destination.
item.splitter.desc: Splits a signal to adjacent blocks.
item.jet_boots.desc: Jump in mid air to activate, has 1 second of fuel.
item.jumping_bean.desc: Increase melee damage by 20%, with a catch.
item.gecko_gloves.desc: Wearing these gloves lets you climb up surfaces.
item.speed_boots.desc: Wearing these gives you the energy to run around.
item.armour_potion.desc: Increases your defence by 10 points for 5 minutes.
item.flight_potion.desc: Allows you to do a short rocket boost for 1 minute.
item.cure_cube.desc: Equipping this makes you immune to poison.
item.brick.desc: To throw at things you dont like.
item.throwable_torch.desc: Can be thrown to light up caves.
item.bomb_berry.desc: Warning: Do not eat in house.
item.forest_blessing.desc: Grants an extra 2 seconds of stamina.
item.minecart.desc: Place on a rail to ride.
item.painting_triangle.desc: The fundamental building block for life.
item.wallpaper.desc: Can only be applied to Drywall.
item.big_snowball.desc: Do you want to build a snowman?
item.crate_potion.desc: Increases the chances of fishing up a crate.
item.worm.desc: Used as bait to attract rarer fish.
item.bug_bait.desc: Used as bait to attract rarer fish.
item.rage_bait.desc: Attracts rarer fish but makes them angrier.
item.magnetic_bait.desc: Increases the odds of fishing up a crate.
item.elevator.desc: Jump or sneak to go up and down.
item.jelly_spoon.desc: Allows you to phase through Forest Jelly when equipped.
item.spoon_fragment.desc: Can be combined to make something useful.
item.desert_glider.desc: The pink makes you go faster.
item.quicksand.desc: This gives you a sinking feeling...
item.lush_grass_seed.desc: Plant on dirt to grow grass.
item.forest_grass_seed.desc: Plant on dirt to grow grass.
item.dry_grass_seed.desc: Plant on dirt to grow grass.
item.gold_flower: A testament to your dedication for growing flowers.
guide.open_menu.name: Beginning
guide.open_menu.desc: Welcome to the Adventure Guide! This guide will slowly reveal new things to do as you progress through the game. Don't worry, following this guide is completely optional, but if you get stuck, check here first!
guide.pickup_rocks.name: Pick up Rocks
guide.pickup_rocks.desc: You will want to pick up some flint for primitive tools. Five will be enough for the next step.
guide.chop_tree.name: Punch Wood
guide.chop_tree.desc: An unavoidable step in any good adventure. The hero must defeat the tree to start their journey.
guide.make_workbench.name: Make a Workbench
guide.make_workbench.desc: With the logs you now have in your possession, open your inventory and turn them into planks via the crafting menu. With 5 planks, you can make a workbench.
guide.pickaxe.name: Flint Pickaxe
guide.pickaxe.desc: You will need a flint pickaxe for breaking stone and dirt blocks. The "Swing Speed" stat determines how fast you break blocks.
guide.sword.name: Flint Sword
guide.sword.desc: You will want a sword to defend yourself from the creatures of the night. The flint sword is very weak and you will want to make an upgrade as soon as possible.
guide.axe.name: Flint Axe
guide.axe.desc: Axes can chop wood materials faster than other tools.
guide.night_danger.name: Night is Coming!
guide.night_danger.desc: You first night will be the most difficult. You cannot easily skip the night, so focus on preparing a safe place! Try to get some armour and tools ASAP. Don't be scared to go mining.
guide.biomes.name: Stick to the Forest!
guide.biomes.desc: Biomes are tiered in difficulty. Wandering into the snow or desert biome too early will mean certain death! The forest is the easiest biome, so start there.
guide.make_housing.name: Housing
guide.make_housing.desc: It's recommended that you start making houses so that people can move in. Make sure you have an enclosed, well lit room, and place an NPC Sign in to make sure that it's valid housing.
guide.decoration_station.name: Furnishings
guide.decoration_station.desc: You can buy a Decoration Station from the Merchant. This unlocks many useful and decorative items. Placing furniture in an NPC's room will increase their happiness.
guide.make_bed.name: Beds
guide.make_bed.desc: Sleeping in a bed requires a comfortable room. To pass the night quickly, the room should also be well decorated. Beds can be used to speed up time, but they wont let you instantly skip the night.
guide.make_chair.name: Chairs
guide.make_chair.desc: Chairs are a simple furniture item that can spice up a room.
guide.block_shaping.name: Block Shaping
guide.block_shaping.desc: You can change the shape of any full block either using the hammer or the shape selection menu. Don't forget that common controls are listed at the bottom right of the screen.
guide.block_painting.name: Painting
guide.block_painting.desc: You can paint any block in the game using a paint roller. Paint typically applies a tint to a block, meaning that a white tint does nothing. Some blocks, like stone bricks, will have custom textures that allow white paint.
guide.copper_ore.name: Copper Ore
guide.copper_ore.desc: Copper ore is the first tier of material above flint.
guide.coal_ore.name: Coal Deposit
guide.coal_ore.desc: You should consider finding coal quickly. Coal can be found exposed on the surface or in caves.
guide.furnace.name: Furnace
guide.furnace.desc: You will need a furnace to convert your ores into bars.
guide.copper_ingot.name: Copper
guide.copper_ingot.desc: Copper opens up a lot of new recipes, including armours, bows, and other tools.
guide.make_torch.name: Torches
guide.make_torch.desc: Torches can be made with wood and coal. Make sure you get some quickly, as night time can be dark. They can also be found
guide.iron_ingot.name: Iron
guide.silver_ingot.name: Silver
guide.gold_ingot.name: Gold
guide.heart_beet.name: Heart Beet
guide.heart_beet.desc: This useful plant has a special effect when consumed.
guide.sneakers.name: Sneakers
guide.sneakers.desc: This trinket allows you to sneak when equipped.
guide.iron_crossbow.name: Iron Crossbow
guide.iron_crossbow.desc: Crossbows allow you to shoot arrows automatically by holding down the fire button.
guide.iron_bow.name: Iron Bow
guide.iron_bow.desc: Bows are better for long range combat, and deal more damage the longer the bow is charged.
guide.shuriken.name: Shuriken
guide.shuriken.desc: Shuriken are cheap and useful throwing stars and deal a decent amount of damage. They are abundant in crates underground.
guide.potion_station.name: Potion Station
guide.potion_station.desc: Use this to craft potions. Potions are very useful for providing buffs in battle.
guide.silver_armour.name: Silver Armour
guide.silver_armour.desc: Equip a piece of silver armour.
guide.ominous_skull.name: Ominous Skull
guide.ominous_skull.desc: This skull emits a dull glow. Prepare to face your fears.
guide.forest_key.name: Forest Key
guide.forest_key.desc: This is the key to a mysterious dungeon found in the forest. Look for a large tree stump.
guide.spoon.name: Jelly Spoon
guide.spoon.desc: This is a trinket, if you have it equipped you can phase through certain blocks. This is not something you find, you make it by combining spoon fragments dropped by enemies within the dungeon.
guide.forest_pickaxe.name: Forest Pickaxe
guide.forest_pickaxe.desc: With this tool, you now have the ability to go deeper. (Try digging down!)
guide.forest_blessing.name: Forest Blessing
guide.forest_blessing.desc: This item gives you a one time boost to your stamina.
guide.forest_flower.name: Forest Flower
guide.forest_flower.desc: A useful material found in the undergrowth.
guide.forest_ingot.name: Forest Ingot
guide.forest_ingot.desc: An alloy of forest flowers and thorns.
guide.farming_node.name: Farming
guide.farming_node.desc: Setting up a farm to grow crops is a good idea. Crops are used for potions and also for utility.
guide.watering_can.name: The Manual Way
guide.watering_can.desc: You can water crops by hand with a watering can. Crops will stay watered for a while and will only grow when hydrated.
guide.sprinkler.name: The Automatic Way
guide.sprinkler.desc: Sprinklers can be used to water your crops automatically. Place them down and they will water anything in a 5x5 area around it.
guide.wheat.name: Wheat
guide.wheat.desc: Wheat is a common crop and is used as an ingredient for potions and bread.
guide.arrowroot.name: Arrowroot
guide.arrowroot.desc: Arrowroot is a rare crop you can only get via mutation. It's an alternative to arrows that you can grow instead of craft.
guide.bomb_berry.name: Bomb Berry
guide.bomb_berry.desc: Bomb berries are berries that explode when you throw them. They sometimes appear if you leave empty space in your farmland while growing other crops.
guide.fishing_rod.name: Fishing Rod
guide.fishing_rod.desc: Fishing can be used to get potion ingredients, and you also keep a catalogue of the fish you catch.
guide.sprint_boots.name: Add Sprinting Pls
guide.sprint_boots.desc: These boots allow you to sprint! You have a limited amount of stamina, which can be raised later on.
guide.rose.name: By Any Other Name
guide.rose.desc: Not only can you water crops, but watering other blocks, like grass, will cause other flowers and plants to grow, some of which are rare and exclusive to this mechanic.
guide.to_the_snow.name: To the Snow!
guide.to_the_snow.desc: It's time to continue your adventure in the snow biome. Explore and have fun!
guide.ice_arrow.name: Ice Arrow
guide.ice_arrow.desc: These arrows are stronger than normal, AND they deal freezing damage. BRR!
guide.snowball.name: Snowballs
guide.snowball.desc: Snowballs don't pack a lot of punch on their own, but they can be used as ammo for other weapons.
guide.mint_crop.name: Free Mint(s)!
guide.mint_crop.desc: Mint can be found in the snow biome, and is used as a potion ingredient.
guide.frost_algae.name: Frost Algae
guide.frost_algae.desc: Frost algae looks pretty, but it can also be used in potions.
guide.cobalt_shuriken.name: Cobalt Shuriken
guide.cobalt_shuriken.desc: A snowball with blades in it. How terrifying!
guide.snow_cannon.name: Snowball Cannon
guide.snow_cannon.desc: This cannon shoots snowballs with such force that they actually really hurt!
guide.cobalt_ore.name: Cobalt Ore
guide.cobalt_ore.desc: You won't be able to get much done without cobalt, so get mining!
guide.ice_cap.name: Ice Cap
guide.ice_cap.desc: These mushrooms are cold to the touch - but secretly harbour a lot of warmth within, the source of their vibrant glow.
guide.cobalt_ingot.name: Cobalt Ingot
guide.cobalt_ingot.desc: Make the ore into bars. You know the drill.
guide.cobalt_spear.name: Cobalt Spear
guide.cobalt_spear.desc: A new type of weapon to skewer your enemies. Does stronger damage but doesn't do a sweep attack, targeting only the enemy you are looking at.
guide.cobalt_armour.name: Cobalt Armour
guide.cobalt_armour.desc: At least one piece of cobalt armour is a must if you want to survive the coming challenges.
guide.frozen_heart.name: Frozen Heart
guide.frozen_heart.desc: This heart is cold and uncaring, and equipping it makes you feel the same way! This new state of being increases your immunity to the cold.
guide.jet_boots.name: Jet Boots
guide.jet_boots.desc: These things will send you flying upwards with a burst of energy. Just make sure you can make your way back down without going splat.
guide.gecko_gloves.name: Gecko Gloves
guide.gecko_gloves.desc: Geckos have the awesome ability to climb walls, and with these, you do too!
guide.giant_snowball.name: Giant Snowball
guide.giant_snowball.desc: Giant snowballs for a giant snowman.
guide.evil_tophat.name: Evil Tophat
guide.evil_tophat.desc: Deep in the dungeon, place the snowballs and hat on top of the pedestal to make it come to life.
guide.spawn_snow_boss.name: Snow Spirit
guide.ice_pickaxe.name: Ice Pickaxe
guide.ice_pickaxe.desc: With this pickaxe, you now have the ability to break new blocks, such as the snow dungeon walls, and some of the resources in the desert.
guide.snow_dungeon_bricks.name: Snow Dungeon Bricks
guide.snow_dungeon_bricks.desc: Take this you pesky dungeon! I didn't like you anyway.
guide.to_the_desert.name: To the Desert!
guide.to_the_desert.desc: The next stop on your adventure is the desert biome. Before you go up, you will have to go down!
guide.palladium_ore.name: Palladium Ore
guide.palladium_ore.desc: This is the metal of the desert.
guide.palladium_ingot.name: Palladium Ingot
guide.palladium_ingot.desc: Refined Palladium that is great for tools, weapons, and keys.
guide.desert_key_fragment.name: Key Fragment
guide.desert_key.name: Desert Key
guide.desert_key.desc: The desert dungeon key to the desert dungeon door.
guide.make_table.name: Table
guide.make_table.desc: Tables are cool. Eating without one will give a -3 debuff to mood. (Not really)
guide.make_lamp.name: Lamp
guide.make_lamp.desc: This is a basic lamp you can use for decoration. Painting the lampshade will also change the colour.
guide.desert_shuriken.name: Desert Shuriken
guide.desert_shuriken.desc: This is a reinforced shuriken made with cacti and palladium. Its spikes pack a punch.
guide.desert_glider.name: Desert Glider
guide.desert_glider.desc: This glider will let you fly twice as fast as a regular one. Very useful for decending from the desert dungeon roof.
guide.cool_sword.name: Cool Sword
guide.cool_sword.desc: This cool sword marks the end of your progression journey for now. I hope you had fun :)
settings.language_info: Please restart to fully apply language choice.
effect.desc.slowfall: You fall slower and don't take fall damage.
effect.desc.healcooldown: You must wait a moment before you can heal again.
effect.desc.freezing: You are taking damage from the cold.
effect.desc.frozen: You are frozen, and can't do anything!
effect.desc.armoured: Your defence is increased by 4 points.
effect.desc.snack: You had a snack, tiny boost to stats.
effect.desc.small_meal: You had a small meal, small boost to stats.
effect.desc.webbed: You are tangled in a spider web.
effect.desc.crate_potion: Greater chance of fishing up a crate.
loading.tip0: Enemies will only spawn on naturally generating blocks.
loading.tip1: Press the view recipe keybind to view an item's recipes.
loading.tip2: You can change any blocks shape with the change shape keybind.
loading.tip3: Crops can mutate if you leave empty farmland.
loading.tip4: Watch out for traps underground and in dungeons.
loading.tip5: You can place rails upside down and on walls.
loading.tip6: Torches don't prevent monster spawning underground.
loading.tip7: Use a Respawn Pointer to set your spawn.
loading.tip8: Use Returning Potions to return home if you are lost.
loading.tip9: CTRL click items to send them to the trash slot.
loading.tip10: You can automatically stack items to nearby chests.
loading.tip12: Some weapons can block attacks from enemies.
loading.tip13: Use a Decoration Station to make lots of cool items.
loading.tip14: Make tools using flint rocks and a Workbench.
loading.tip15: A strong pickaxe can break through to the other side.
loading.tip16: Sometimes, it's a good idea to dig straight down.
loading.tip17: If you find a bug, please report it on the Discord.
loading.tip18: Have feedback? Join the discord or fill out the feedback form.
loading.tip19: Tool durability isn't real, and can't hurt you.
loading.tip20: If you let weeds grow in your garden, they may mutate..
loading.tip21: Place an NPC sign for townsfolk to move in.
loading.tip22: Playing basketball during a boss fight can be beneficial.
loading.tip23: Heart beets can be used to increase your maximum health.
loading.tip24: Explosive arrows are dangerous in close combat.
loading.tip25: Crops will only grow if you water them.
comfort.room_size.too_big: This is not an enclosed space.
comfort.room_sunlight.pass: There's a perfect amount of sunlight.
comfort.Horrified.as_npc: This place is horrible! What have you done!?.
comfort.Inhospitable.as_npc: I don't like this place at all!
comfort.Uncomfortable.as_npc: This place isn't very nice... I feel uncomfortable here.
comfort.Acceptable.as_npc: This place is alright... I guess.
comfort.Comfortable.as_npc: I like it here. Things are good.
comfort.VeryComfortable.as_npc: This place is great! I am enjoying my time here.
npc.merchant.name: Merchant
npc.merchant.generic0: Lamp oil. Rope. Bombs? You want it? Too bad, I only have one of those things.
npc.merchant.generic1: If you can believe it, I used to be a block. Well, maybe that's a little too outlandish....
npc.merchant.generic2: Do you like my hat? It just exudes oppulence. Doesn't it make you want to buy something?
npc.merchant.generic3: How are you my friend? Perhaps some merchandise will cheer you up!
npc.merchant.generic4: I am a merchant. I sell items. Buy my stuff.
npc.merchant.generic5: Don't just stare blankly at me like that, give me some of your money!
npc.merchant.generic6: Trust me, I'm not sneaky. I haven't even found any sneakers yet!
npc.merchant.generic7: I've been considering switching to a subscription based model, what do you think?
npc.merchant.generic8: Thanks for checking in with me. You know what would cheer me right up? If you bought something!
npc.merchant.generic9: Don't worry, I wont run out of things to sell. How, you ask? Well, I have my sources!
npc.merchant.refuse0: I'm not selling you anything until my living situation improves!
npc.merchant.refuse1: This place is absolutely dreadful. Please fix this abhorrent living quarters!
npc.merchant.refuse2: How am I supposed to conduct business in a room like this? This is no place for a distinguished gentleman such as myself!
npc.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
npc.blacksmith.generic0: Let's forge this ingot, let's forge this ingot to perfection with hammers!
npc.blacksmith.generic1: I used to know how to smash geodes open but I forgot. Maybe I will remember someday.
npc.blacksmith.generic2: How did I lose my finger? Well, I picked my nose and it got stuck. How'd I lose my eye? You don't wanna know...
npc.blacksmith.generic3: I heard there is a legendary blacksmith who was able to forge some plot armour. It's a bit of a long story, but they turned out okay in the end.
npc.blacksmith.generic4: Whenever I visit a new town I always beeline straight to the blacksmith. They've always got something good going on.
npc.blacksmith.generic5: If you melt down all of your possessions into one giant amorphous blob it can be a lot easier to transport.
npc.blacksmith.generic6: I heard that deep below the forest there is a flower that is stronger than gold. It might be worth digging down sometimes.
npc.blacksmith.generic7: Always temper your expectations, and your metal.
npc.blacksmith.generic8: Do you prefer to call them ingots or bars? Either way I'm still smashing it with a hammer.
npc.blacksmith.generic9: Some ores need stronger pickaxes to break. I heard there's a strong pickaxe in the Forest Dungeon.
npc.blacksmith.refuse0: I can't sell you anything without proper equipment. Could you please provide a better room?
npc.blacksmith.refuse1: This room may be enough to get by, but I will need a better place to work in order to trade.
npc.blacksmith.refuse2: I miss the heat of the forge. Could you spice things up with a bit of lava, first?
npc.farmer.name: Farmer
npc.farmer.generic0: Recently I've decided to start investigating modern farming techniques, such as engagement farming.
npc.farmer.generic1: I have farming supplies in stock if you are interested.
npc.farmer.generic2: If you leave room around your plants, they may spread on their own. Sometimes they mutate and turn into an entirely different plant.
npc.farmer.generic3: Weeds can be annoying, but if you leave them alone for a while they might grow something new.
npc.farmer.generic4: If you don't want to water your crops, make sure to place a sprinkler. They can water plants in a 5x5 area, and run automatically.
npc.farmer.generic5: Plants can be used to make all sorts of potions. It's not my expertise, but I've heard blueberries make an excellent reagent.
npc.farmer.generic6: You don't need to worry about the quality of my stock. Trust me, I am not a seedy person.
npc.farmer.generic7: Even if you are not interested in farming, tilling soil is a good source of worms. I don't find worms particularly tasty myself, but I wont judge.
npc.farmer.generic8: Sometimes, the only way to get a plant is to explore. You wont find everything all in one place.
npc.farmer.generic9: Plant's love moist soil, but so do weeds. Weeds can spread a lot quicker than plants, so watch out!
npc.farmer.refuse0: My stock doesn't appear out of thin air, I need somewhere to work. Could you make a greenhouse for me?
npc.farmer.refuse1: I want to feel the sun on my skin. Before I trade with you, I would prefer a more suitable living arrangement.
npc.farmer.refuse2: This room is far too dim to grow plants in. I need some sunlight!
npc.builder.name: Builder
npc.builder.generic0: I like building brown bricks! It's the best thing and the most fun anyone can possibly have!
npc.builder.generic1: I sell a lot of useful building materials. Wallpaper, paint, decorations, I have it all!
npc.builder.generic2: One time I had a client who insisted living in an unlit, isolated room. I thought they were a vampire, but it turned out they just hated windows.
npc.builder.generic3: If you ever get a contract for beige wallpaper and carpet, say no! I made that mistake once and I couldn't finish the job. The rooms just never ended!
npc.builder.generic4: Don't forget you don't need a hammer to change block shapes. You can bring up the menu while holding a block, and it will remember the shape!
npc.builder.generic5: Most blocks can be re-shaped, even the weird ones. If you are making a dirt hut, at least surround it with a dirt fence!
npc.builder.generic6: If you don't like the colour of a light, paint it! Paint will tint light sources and change the colour they emit.
npc.builder.generic7: If a block doesn't have a unique painted texture, white paint will probably have no effect. Paint tints a block's colour, so tinting a black block still results in black.
npc.builder.generic8: Wallpaper is great if you want thin walls between rooms. Each side of a wallpaper base block can have a unique wallpaper applied.
npc.builder.generic9: Make sure you build on a stable foundation. If you don't, you might end up spending 3 months working on netcode!
npc.builder.refuse0: Before I sell to you, would you mind improving my workspace? I need a place to craft things.
npc.builder.refuse1: I need some crafting stations before I can create any stock for you.
npc.builder.refuse2: I don't think I can make anything for you until I have the appropriate crafting stations, sorry.
ui.generic.open_compendium: Open the compendium from the pause menu to hide this message.
